subhead: Not a mockup, not a pitch deck. A real café site you can look at on your phone right now.
note: We’re Tom and Phoebe. We build websites for independent cafés - the kind of place that already has the coffee, the regulars and the reviews, but nothing to send people to.
Scan the code and you’ll see a full café site: menu, hours, photos, order-ahead. Yours would be the same, built with your name, your photos and your prices - and we build it before you pay a penny.
Like it? It’s £30 a month, cancel anytime. Don’t? Keep the card, no hard feelings.
